item.description: Anthropic PBC is planning to file publicly for an initial public offering Monday at around 9 a.m. in New York, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence model maker nears a potentially record-breaking debut.

item.title: Review: Apollo Takes Stake in Mubadala Capital, Deepening Abu Dhabi Ties
item.description: Apollo Global Management Inc. is buying a stake in Mubadala Capital, the alternative asset management arm of the $385 billion Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund, in a deal that will significantly deepen its ties to the oil-rich emirate.
